story: 为什么切洋葱会流泪？洋葱细胞破裂后释放酶，产生一种挥发性的含硫化合物，刺激眼睛，泪腺分泌眼泪来冲洗。冷藏洋葱或用锋利的刀可以减轻。

storyboard.title: 切洋葱为什么流泪？
storyboard.logline: 洋葱细胞破裂后释放刺激性气体，触发眼睛自我保护机制。

shots.visual: 一颗完整紫皮洋葱放在木质砧板上，旁边一把闪亮厨刀，一滴水珠正从洋葱表面滑落，右上角浮现问号气泡

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 切洋葱时，为什么总会忍不住流泪？

shots.imagePrompt: Flat illustration, 9:16 vertical frame, light blue and mint green color palette. A whole purple-skinned onion on a wooden cutting board, beside it a shiny stainless steel kitchen knife. One water droplet sliding down the onion surface. A cartoon-style question mark bubble floating in upper right corner. Clean infographic style, no text overlay.
shots.videoPrompt: Water droplet slides slowly down onion surface; subtle shimmer on knife blade

shots.visual: 放大洋葱细胞结构：外层细胞壁破裂，释放小圆点状酶分子（标'Alliinase'），与含硫物质碰撞生成挥发性'催泪因子'（LF）气体分子向上飘散

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 洋葱细胞破裂，酶与硫化合物反应，生成挥发性‘催泪因子’。

shots.imagePrompt: Flat illustration, white background with soft blue grid lines. Cross-section of onion cell: intact cells on left, ruptured cells on right. Enzyme molecules labeled 'Alliinase' (blue circles) colliding with sulfur compounds (yellow triangles), producing floating tear-inducing factor (LF) gas molecules (red teardrop-shaped particles) rising upward. All elements simplified, infographic style, no text beyond labels.
shots.videoPrompt: Red LF particles float upward from ruptured cells; gentle pulse animation on collision zone

shots.visual: 人眼侧面剖视图：LF气体接触角膜，触发神经信号传至脑干，激活泪腺分泌泪水，泪水经泪管流下

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 它刺激角膜神经，大脑立刻命令泪腺冲洗——眼泪就来了。

shots.imagePrompt: Flat illustration, light lavender-gray background. Side-view schematic of human eye: cornea (outer layer), trigeminal nerve (orange line) connecting to brainstem, lacrimal gland (blue almond shape above eye), tear duct (curved blue tube). Red LF particles touching cornea; blue tear drops flowing down duct. Clear labels only for 'Cornea', 'Nerve', 'Lacrimal Gland', 'Tear Duct'. No facial features beyond eye outline.
shots.videoPrompt: Red LF particles make contact with cornea; blue tear drops begin flowing downward along duct

shots.visual: 左右分屏：左侧是带冰晶特效的冷藏洋葱（温度计显示4°C），右侧是锋利刀刃切开洋葱截面，截面光滑无汁液飞溅

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 冷藏降低酶活性，锋利刀减少细胞损伤——试试看！
